title: Scholia v0.7 proposed Map/Event/Task semantic conformance suite
description: Self-describing positive and negative fixtures for the proposed additive Map/Event/Task contract (SCHOLIA_v0.7_SPEC.md). Each case declares its input format, payload, and — for negative cases — the expected failure phase (parse: the input never becomes an atom; validate: a constructed atom or trace is rejected) plus the proposed rule code and a required diagnostic subset. Positive cases declare round-trip (XML→JSON→YAML→XML semantic equality, IDs/canonical IDs/typed values retained, children empty) and repeated-canonical-JSON stability expectations, and optionally a canonical-identity relation between named atoms. Implementations claiming the proposed contract execute every case with zero skips; case counts are pinned in coverage and may not shrink silently. Nothing in this suite executes work: parsing or validating a Task never starts one, and opaque external/runtime correlators are never dereferenced.

case_fields.category: positive (must pass) or negative (must fail as declared).
case_fields.kinds: New kinds exercised by the case.
case_fields.format: xml | json | yaml (payload is document text) or dict (payload is the in-memory mapping input).
case_fields.payload_b: Optional second document for cross-trace identity probes.
case_fields.profile: Optional explicit grammar profile the case is evaluated under.
case_fields.coverage: Optional structured annotation of field→target-kind pairs the case covers.
case_fields.identity: Optional canonical-identity expectation: relation equal|distinct over atoms (same trace) or cross_trace_atom (payload vs payload_b).
case_fields.expects: outcome pass|fail; negative cases add phase (parse|validate), rule, diagnostic_must_mention; positive cases add roundtrip and canonical_json_stable.

unknown_kind.contract: closed-set atom catalog; unknown kinds never parse.

semantic_unknown_field.contract: closed per-kind field sets across XML/JSON/YAML/dict input.

semantic_children_empty.contract: new kinds carry no nested child atoms.

semantic_operators_list.contract: operators is a list of strings; no coercion.

map_entries_shape.contract: entries is a real mapping with unique string keys; embedded-JSON and document duplicate keys are rejected while decoding.

semantic_id_shape.contract: required kind-prefixed trace-local ID with [A-Za-z0-9_]+ suffix.

semantic_id_unique.contract: no ID collision involving a new atom anywhere in the trace, including Steps and legacy atoms.

map_entries_typed.contract: homogeneous values matching value_type; empty keys, bool-as-integer, out-of-range integers, floats, nulls, arrays, nested objects, and mixed types rejected.

map_ref_resolves.contract: atom_ref values resolve to a declared non-Step atom other than the Map itself.

event_required_fields.contract: source, occurrence_id, event_type, and a nonempty body are required.

event_timestamp_shape.contract: RFC3339 with explicit timezone; impossible date/time rejected; excluded from canonical identity.

event_occurrence_unique.contract: (source, occurrence_id) unique per trace, even for identical bodies.

task_required_fields.contract: status and a nonempty body are required.

task_status_enum.contract: status is exactly open|satisfied|unsatisfied|withdrawn; runtime lifecycle states rejected.

semantic_ref_target_kind.contract: declared reference fields resolve to their permitted target kinds; dangling or wrong-kind targets rejected.

canonical_id_well_formed.contract: unchanged: claimed canonical_id must be well-formed and match the recomputed value.

grammar_profile_unsupported.contract: new kinds under an explicit legacy 0.6.2 profile, and unknown profiles, produce a structured unsupported-version diagnostic.

runtime_obligations: no_side_effects: constructor/parse/validate/roundtrip run under subprocess/network/filesystem-write denial; a semantic Task never executes work, closes a required Goal by itself, or substitutes for a required Action result.
forced_canonical_collision: a truncated-hash collision forced through a test seam is reported, never overwritten or merged; contradictory registry overwrites are refused.

canonical_id_reference_resolution: local reference fields also accept an exact canonical ID; fixtures cannot carry a correct hash without executing the hash algorithm, so this is exercised by the implementing suite.

legacy_artifact_probe: the actual installed legacy 0.7.2 artifact accepts the legacy corpus and fails on new kinds with its real unknown-kind exception, reported separately from the adapter's structured grammar_profile_unsupported diagnostic.
packaging_parity: clean source, wheel, and sdist installs report the same versions/kind catalog and pass this exact suite from outside the source roots.

cases.description: All three proposed kinds coexist with legacy atoms in one Step; legacy semantics unchanged.
cases.payload:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Goal id="G_01" scope="trace">Ship the fixture change.</Goal>
  <Action id="A_01">Edited the fixture.<Finding id="F_01">The fixture compiles.</Finding></Action>
  <Map id="Map_inputs" value_type="string" entries="{"format":"xml"}">Inputs.</Map>
  <Task id="Task_01" status="open" input_map="Map_inputs" for_goal="G_01">Review the fixture output.</Task>
  <Event id="Event_01" source="worker" occurrence_id="occ-1" event_type="unit.recorded" for_task="Task_01">The occurrence was recorded.</Event>
  <Concluding id="C_01" for_goal="G_01" status="met">REFER:F_01 closes the goal.</Concluding>
</Step>
